data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 3s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: services
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['gateway:8080','ordering:8080','inventory:8080','payments:8080','worker:8080','control:8080']
  - job_name: rabbitmq
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['rabbitmq:15692']

containers.name: init
command: until curl -fsS http://toxiproxy:8474/version; do sleep 2; done; curl -fsS -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @/config/proxies.json http://toxiproxy:8474/populate
